descr: Gemini 3.8 Flash leads in chat while Kimi K3 scores higher in coding.
risposta: Gemini 3.8 Flash is ahead in the overall Arena comparison. It has a higher chat score (1497 vs 1487) and wins the blind vote about 51% of the time. Kimi K3 scores better in coding, but the chat advantage makes Gemini the stronger all-round choice.
dimensioni: Gemini 3.8 Flash does not disclose its model size, so download information is unavailable. Kimi K3 is 2779.9 B total (104.6 B active) and requires roughly 1686 GB for a 4-bit download.
velocita: Both models run only via online services on current consumer hardware. Gemini 3.8 Flash is listed as online-only for RTX 3090, RTX 4090, RTX 5090, RX 7900 XTX, Mac M4 Max 128 GB, and Ryzen AI Max+ 395 128 GB. Kimi K3 does not fit any of these home machines either.
gratisA: Gemini 3.8 Flash can be accessed for free through Google’s Gemini API free tier. The model is proprietary and not available for local download.
gratisB: Kimi K3 is free to download and run at home under the Kimi K3 license. Open weights let you host the model yourself without a cloud service.
sceglieA: Pick Gemini 3.8 Flash when you need the best chat performance in the Arena. Its higher chat score indicates stronger conversational abilities. It is also convenient if you prefer a managed API over local setup.
sceglieB: Choose Kimi K3 if coding tasks are your priority, as it leads in the coding category. The open-weight release lets you run the model locally, provided you can store the large download. It is also a good fit for developers who want full control over the model.

categorie.Chat: Gemini 3.8 Flash wins the chat category with a score of 1497, while Kimi K3 scores 1487. The chat lead makes Gemini the preferred option for conversational use.
categorie.Coding: Kimi K3 outperforms Gemini 3.8 Flash in coding, scoring 1658 against 1585. For programming assistance, Kimi K3 is the stronger candidate.
